content:
### 1) LAYOUT & REGIONS
*   **Window:** 1024x768 (Maximized, standard Windows chrome).
*   **Title Bar (0, 0 - 1024, 40):** Contains app icon/title (left), "Buy Now" CTA (center-right), and window controls (right).
*   **Toolbar Cluster (0, 40 - 1024, 100):**
    *   **Nav/Breadcrumb (10, 60 - 300, 95):** Home icon, Back/Forward/Up buttons, and current path display.
    *   **View Controls (645, 55 - 990, 100):** View toggle, Filter button, Search input.
*   **Filter Bar Row (0, 105 - 1024, 155):** Dropdowns for Show/File Type/Date Modified/File Size, AI Recommend toggle, and Delete action.
*   **Main Content Area (0, 160 - 1024, 855):** Split into three vertical panes.
    *   **Tree Pane (5, 165 - 275, 850):** Navigation tree with Path/Type tabs at the top.
    *   **File List Pane (280, 165 - 800, 850):** Column headers and scrollable list of items.
    *   **Preview/Details Pane (805, 165 - 995, 850):** Contextual info for the selected item.
*   **Status Bar / Footer (0, 856 - 1024, 945):** Scan status summary (left) and primary "Recover All..." action (right).

---

### 2) TEXT (VERBATIM)
*   **Title Bar:** `EaseUS Data Recovery Wizard Free`
*   **Toolbar:**
    *   `Buy Now` (Button)
    *   `Windows (C:)` (Breadcrumb)
    *   `Filter` (Button)
    *   `Search files or folders` (Placeholder)
*   **Filter Bar:**
    *   `Show`, `File Type`, `Date Modified`, `File Size` (Dropdown labels)
    *   `AI Recommend` (Label)
*   **Tree Tabs:** `Path`, `Type`
*   **Tree Items:**
    *   `Windows (C:)` | `1.1M`
    *   `File Path Lost` | `4.3K`
    *   `Reconstructed` | `87`
*   **List Headers:** `Name`, `Date Modified`, `Type`
*   **List Rows (Sample):**
    *   `actionarchivecache` | `10/7/2026 11:30 PM` | `File folder`
    *   `actions-runner` | `10/17/2026 7:34 PM` | `File folder`
    *   `azureCli` | `10/8/2026 1:50 AM` | `File folder`
    *   ... (other folders follow same pattern)
*   **Preview Pane:**
    *   `actionarchivecache` (Filename)
    *   `Open` (Button)
    *   `Size:` | `284 MB`
    *   `Date Modified:` | `10/7/2026 11:30 PM`
    *   `Path:` | `C:\`
*   **Footer Status:** `Scan Completed, Files Found: 1139234 (146.93 GB)`
*   **Footer Action:** `Recover All ...`

---

### 3) COLOR (ESTIMATED HEX)
*   **Backgrounds:**
    *   Window/App BG: `#F5F8FC` (Very light blue-grey)
    *   List Item Selected: `#D6E8FF` (Light blue)
    *   List Item Hover/Alt Row: `#F0F4F8`
    *   Preview Pane BG: `#FFFFFF`
    *   Tree Pane BG: `#FFFFFF`
*   **Accents & CTAs:**
    *   Primary Button (Recover All): `#2B7FFF` -> `#1A6AE8` (Gradient/Shadow effect)
    *   Buy Now Button: `#FFAA00` (Orange/Yellow)
    *   Filter/Search Icons: `#5B9AFF` (Blue)
    *   Folder Icon Fill: `#8BBEF7`
*   **Text:**
    *   Primary Text (Names): `#333333`
    *   Secondary Text (Dates/Sizes): `#666666`
    *   Link Text (AI Recommend): `#0066CC`
    *   White Text on Blue: `#FFFFFF`
*   **Borders:**
    *   Input Borders: `#D1D5DB`
    *   Divider Lines: `#E5E7EB`

---

### 4) TYPOGRAPHY
*   **Window Title:** Segoe UI, ~9pt, Regular.
*   **Headings/Buttons:** Segoe UI Semibold, ~12-13pt.
*   **List Content (Names):** Segoe UI, ~12pt, Regular.
*   **Metadata (Dates/Sizes):** Segoe UI, ~11pt, Regular, Dark Grey.
*   **Status Bar Summary:** Segoe UI, ~13pt, Regular.

---

### 5) SPACING & SIZING
*   **Row Height:** ~42px (List items), ~36px (Tree items).
*   **Control Heights:**
    *   Search Box: ~32px.
    *   Buttons (Filter/View): ~32px.
    *   Primary CTA (Recover): ~40px.
*   **Padding:**
    *   List Item Left Padding: ~12px (after checkbox).
    *   Pane Gutter: ~5px.
    *   Preview Pane Internal Padding: ~20px.
*   **Radii:**
    *   Buttons: ~4px (slightly rounded corners).
    *   Search/Input: ~4px.
    *   Preview Card area: ~8px.
*   **Icon Size:** 16x16px (Standard toolbar), 24x24px (Preview pane large icon), 32x32px (Footer status checkmark).

---

### 6) CONTROLS & STATES
*   **Navigation:**
    *   Back/Forward/Up Buttons: Normal state (Greyed out or default).
    *   Breadcrumb: Static text display.
*   **View Controls:**
    *   List View Icon: Active/Selected (Blue highlight).
    *   Filter Button: Normal.
    *   Search Input: Empty/Placeholder state.
*   **Filter Bar:**
    *   Dropdowns: Collapsed state.
    *   Toggle Switch (AI Recommend): OFF position (Circle left).
*   **Tree View:**
    *   Expand/Collapse Arrows: Visible (`>`).
    *   Selection: `Windows (C:)` is selected (Blue background).
*   **File List:**
    *   Checkboxes: Unchecked (Empty squares).
    *   Sort Indicator: Up arrow on `Name` column header.
    *   Row State: First row (`actionarchivecache`) is **Selected** (Blue background). Others are normal.
*   **Preview Pane:**
    *   `Open` Button: Normal/Enabled state.
*   **Footer:**
    *   `Recover All...` Button: Enabled (Solid blue).
    *   Status Area: Success state (Green checkmark icon visible).

---

### 7) ICONOGRAPHY
*   **Style:** Flat, Outline (for actions), Filled (for file types/status).
*   **Weights:** 1.5px - 2px stroke for outline icons.
*   **Specifics:**
    *   **Folder Icon:** Standard Windows-style folder, light blue fill.
    *   **Checkmark (Footer):** Green filled circle with white check.
    *   **Nav Icons:** House (Home), Chevrons (Back/Fwd/Up).
    *   **Action Icons:** Funnel (Filter), Lines (List View), Magnifying Glass (Search).

---

### 8) STATE ANALYSIS
*   **Page State:** **Success / Data Populated**.
    *   The scan has finished ("Scan Completed").
    *   The list is populated with results (1139234 files found).
    *   A specific item is selected, triggering the preview pane update.
*   **Motion Cues:** None visible (static screenshot), but the selection implies interactivity.
